# Component Inventory
One row per UI component in `docs/build/_registry.md`, with folder, DESIGN.md source, server/client boundary, props, states, tokens, a11y, slice and tests — the contract `design-fidelity-reviewer`, `frontend-reviewer` and `spec-drift-reviewer` diff code against.
Status: **v1.0 — FROZEN 2026-08-17** (changes only via ADR + doc edit in the same PR; `spec-drift-reviewer` enforces) — amended by ADR-0004 (2026-08-17) — amended by ADR-0014 (2026-08-20) — amended by ADR-0018 (2026-08-21) — amended by ADR-0017 (2026-08-21) — amended by ADR-0021 (2026-08-27) — amended by ADR-0028 (2026-09-03) — amended by ADR-0030 (2026-09-03)

Decisions applied: `06-decisions/ADR-0002-spec-reconciliation.md` (binding — every conflict and OPEN default below is settled there; §11 rows are kept for their IDs and marked DECIDED).

Sources: `docs/build/_registry.md` (names, slices), `DESIGN.md` v1.3 (§1–§12; the look), `docs/framework-decision.md` (stack, CSS Modules), `.claude/skills/web-quality/SKILL.md` (Server/Client rules), `.claude/skills/design-fidelity/SKILL.md` (what the gate greps for), `docs/notifications.md` (email components). Sibling docs: routes/pages in `02-routes-and-pages.md`, action shapes in `04-server-contracts.md`, test IDs in `05-test-plan.md`, invariants in `01-architecture.md`.

Column key for the inventory tables in §2: **S/C** = Server Component (`S`), Client Component (`C`, has `'use client'`, reason given; every `C` file appears in the machine-readable client-island list in §1.4), or **shared** (`Sh` — no directive; presentational; renders on either side, becomes client only when imported by a client parent). **Slice** = the slice that introduces the component (registry IDs). **Tests** = the layer(s) `05-test-plan.md` must cover for it (IDs `T-UNIT-n` / `T-E2E-n` are assigned in 05; this doc names the case).

---

## 1. Rules (numbered; each is a yes/no check)

### 1.1 Files and naming
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-01 | Every component in §2 lives at `components/<area>/<Name>.tsx` with a sibling `components/<area>/<Name>.module.css`. `<area>` is the registry group in kebab-case: `layout`, `primitives`, `projects`, `comments`, `accounts`, `videos`, `skins-art`, `seen-on`, `support`, `admin`. Email components live in `emails/` (see §6), never under `components/`. **Exempt from the `.module.css` requirement (no styles; 01 INV-02):** `TrackedLink`, `Icon`, `ToastProvider` (part of `Toast`), `Reply` (thin wrapper), `ViewerProvider` (store only, no markup — ADR-0014). No other exemptions. |
| C-02 | `<Name>` is the registry PascalCase name verbatim (`TypeBadge`, not `ProjectTypeBadge`). Sub-parts (client or server leaves owned by a parent) live in the same folder as `<Name>.<Part>.tsx`, export one component named `<Name><Part>` (file `Nav.MenuButton.tsx` exports `NavMenuButton`; `Nav.Links.tsx` → `NavLinks`; `ArtMasonry.Lightbox.tsx` → `ArtMasonryLightbox`; `AdminShell.Nav.tsx` → `AdminNav`), and are listed in the parent's row. Sub-part files that carry `'use client'` are on the §1.4 list by path. |
| C-03 | Named export only, same as the file: `export function TypeBadge(props: TypeBadgeProps)`. Props type is exported as `<Name>Props`. No default exports (except `app/**` route files, which Next requires). Every component may additionally accept an optional `className` pass-through (merged onto the root element) and `Button` an `onClick` (needed by `app/error.tsx` `reset()`); `NavMenuButton` an optional `panelId` (default `nav-menu`) so `/dev/components` can mount a second instance without a duplicate id; from S1.1 `NavMenuButton` also an optional `viewer?: ReactNode` — the phone panel's `ProfileMenu` slot (N-05; prose addition 2026-08-20, ADR-0014 family, no rule change) — additive to the §2 prop rows, never replacing them (clarified 2026-08-20, S0). S1.1 additions (ADR-0014): `Button` also accepts `ref` (React 19 prop — `InlineConfirm` moves focus to its Cancel button) and `aria-describedby` (a helper line explaining a disabled state); `AdminShell` an optional `mainLandmark?: boolean` (default `true`); `PixelLabel` `as` also allows `'h1'`; `HandleField.onValidity` and `AvatarUpload.onChange` are optional. S1.5 additions (ADR-0030 D19): `Chip` `removeLabel?: string`; `Toggle` `describedBy?: string` (rendered as `aria-describedby` on the input — the `/admin/settings` moderation radios and the `comments_closed_default` switch point at their consequence line); `NotificationMatrix` derives its section-heading ids (`aria-labelledby` targets), field names and the consequence-line ids from `useId()` rather than `sectionTitleId`, so `/dev/components` can mount several instances without duplicate ids — the `NavMenuButton.panelId` precedent. |
| C-04 | CSS Modules only (`<Name>.module.css`). Class names are kebab-case and mirror DESIGN.md's component names: root class = kebab of the component (`.type-badge`, `.exclusive-badge`, `.project-card`, `.filter-bar`); element classes are root-prefixed (`.project-card-title`, `.project-card-foot`). No modifier classes (`.is-active`, `.button--primary`) — variants and states are attributes (C-10, C-11). |
| C-05 | No global CSS except `styles/tokens.css` (tokens) and `styles/globals.css` (reset, `body`, font faces, focus ring, `.visually-hidden`, `prefers-reduced-motion` base). No inline `style=` except for values that are data (masonry column count from props, progress `width: N%`, chart bar heights, `--i` custom-property indexes). |
| C-06 | No CSS-in-JS, no Tailwind, no UI kit, no icon font. Icons come from `components/primitives/Icon.tsx` (inline SVG, §2.2). |
| C-07 | A component may import only from `components/**`, `lib/**` (types, formatters, actions), `next/*`, `react`. Components never import from `app/**` or `supabase/**`. Client components never import `lib/supabase/server.ts`, `lib/supabase/admin.ts`, `lib/env.ts` (server env), or `lib/actions/*` except to pass the action into `<form action>` / `useActionState` (actions are already server-only functions). |

### 1.2 Tokens-only CSS
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-08 | Every colour, spacing, radius, border width, shadow, font-family, font-size, letter-spacing, duration and z-index in a `.module.css` is a `var(--…)` defined in `styles/tokens.css`. Allowed literals: `0`, `2px`/`3px`/`4px` border and outline widths (DESIGN.md §3 fixes them: 2px borders, 3px avatars/focus, 4px admin active bar) and `6px` only for the Toast left bar (§11.1) — never `1px` (hairlines are a ❌ the contrast/grep script flags), `transparent`, `currentColor`, `inherit`, `auto`, `100%`, percentages, `fr`, unitless line-heights, `em` letter-spacing (`.06em`–`.2em`), aspect ratios (`16/9`, `16/10`, `9/16`, `3/4`), and the DESIGN.md dimension numbers (icon sizes, 44px targets, breakpoints) — those must still be `var(--size-…)`/`var(--bp-…)` where a token exists (01 §tokens). Raw hex outside `tokens.css` = ❌ (`design-fidelity` step 1). One exception (ADR-0014): the Google mark in `components/primitives/GoogleSignInButton.tsx` is an inline `<svg aria-hidden>` whose four fills (`#4285F4`, `#34A853`, `#FBBC05`, `#EA4335`) are Google's brand colours — a brand asset, not a design colour; it is the only non-token colour source, lives in TSX (never in a `.module.css`), and those values appear nowhere else. |
| C-09 | `tokens.css` mirrors DESIGN.md §1 names verbatim (`--ink`, `--slab`, … `--white`) plus the derived tokens in §9 of this doc (hexes DESIGN.md states inline without a name). No other colour tokens exist. Light theme tokens are not shipped in v1 (DESIGN.md §1 "optional, later"). |

### 1.3 Variants and states
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-10 | Variants are `data-variant="<value>"` on the root element (`Button`: `primary\|secondary\|ghost\|gold\|gold-ink` — `gold-ink` is registered in `_registry.md` (ADR-0002) and used only inside gold slabs, see the `Button` row; `VideoFacade`: `hero\|upnext\|short\|mention\|card`; `Avatar`: sizes via `data-size`). Values are the DESIGN.md words in kebab-case. |
| C-11 | Interaction states use CSS pseudo-classes only: `:hover`, `:active`, `:focus-visible`, `:disabled` (native `disabled` attribute), `:checked`, `[open]` on `<details>`. Never a JS-driven `data-hover`. |
| C-12 | Logical/lifecycle states are a single `data-state="<value>"` on the root, mutually exclusive, values enumerated per component in §2 (e.g. `HandleField`: `resting\|checking\|available\|invalid`; `UploadWell`: `idle\|dragover\|uploading\|done\|error`; `Comment`: `published\|held\|hidden\|deleted\|editing`). A component with no lifecycle state has no `data-state`. |
| C-13 | Selection/pressed/expanded/invalid/current are ARIA, not data attributes, and CSS keys on the ARIA attribute: `aria-current="page"` (nav), `aria-current="true"` (selected thumb / up-next row / skin card), `aria-current="true"` also on the active FilterBar type link (`<a>`, never `aria-pressed` on a link), `aria-pressed` (LikeButton, SkinViewer3D Spin/Walk — `<button>` only), `aria-checked` (Toggle; `role="radio"` chips inside `role="radiogroup"`: ReportPicker, AmountPicker), `aria-selected` **only** inside `role="listbox"`/`role="tablist"` (no v1 component uses it), `aria-expanded` (burger, ProfileMenu trigger, ChangelogExpander summary), `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` (Field, HandleField, Composer), `aria-busy` (skeleton regions, submitting forms), `aria-disabled="true"` on the unavailable `Chip` (`<span>`, not focusable). |
| C-14 | Boolean flags that are not states use `data-<flag>` with no value: `data-exclusive` (ProjectCard, SkinCard), `data-featured`, `data-own` (Comment), `data-creator`, `data-mod`, `data-anonymous` (LeaderboardRow), `data-compact` (FloatingSupportButton phone), `data-sticky` (GetItPanel desktop). |
| C-15 | Every state DESIGN.md enumerates for a component must be reachable and rendered (`design-fidelity` step 2). Missing state = ❌. Extra states not in DESIGN.md = "UNSPECIFIED" → ADR or `DESIGN.md` edit in the same PR. |

### 1.4 Server / client boundary
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-16 | Server Components by default. `'use client'` appears only in the files listed in the machine-readable client-island list below (C-16a), which is the single source of truth for `'use client'` files (01 INV-08 defers to it; ADR-0002 C1); the two route files `app/error.tsx` and `app/global-error.tsx` (Next requirement, G-03) are the only `'use client'` files outside `components/`. A `'use client'` in any other file = ❌ (`frontend-reviewer` "Boundaries"; `scripts/check-client-islands.mjs`, 01 INV-94, parses the list between the `client-islands:begin/end` markers). |
| C-16a | **Client-island list (machine-readable).** One row per file that may carry `'use client'`. `01` column (historical, informative only): `=` on the 01 INV-08 allowlist as written · `+` added by this doc (now in `_registry.md`; no ADR needed — 01 v0.2 INV-08 names this table as owner) · `≠` 01 lists the parent as client but this doc narrows it to the leaf named. See table after this one. |
| C-17 | Client components receive data as props; they never fetch (01 INV-09: no `fetch`, no Supabase reads, no `lib/data/*`, no `lib/supabase/server.ts`). The explicit exceptions, each a Server Action, a browser-side auth/upload call, or the ADR-0002 C1 session seam: (1) `HandleField` calls the `checkHandle` action (`lib/actions/accounts.ts`); (2) `SkinViewer3D` loads its texture URL (image fetch by skinview3d); (3) `GoogleSignInButton` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth` from `lib/supabase/client.ts` (ADR-0002 C3); (4) `UploadWell` PUTs the file to the `signed_url` returned by the `begin` phase (04 §1.4.5 — the only browser `fetch`/`uploadToSignedUrl` in `components/**`; `AvatarUpload` sends its file inside the parent form's FormData instead); (5) **the session seam (ADR-0002 C1, 01 INV-09/INV-85):** `ViewerProvider` (`components/accounts/ViewerProvider.tsx`) and `CommentThread` (`components/comments/CommentThread.tsx`) read *the viewer's own rows only* through `lib/supabase/client.ts` (anon key + RLS) after hydration (plus, for moderators, the `moderator_thread` RPC rows and the `public_profiles` rows of the authors that RPC introduced — ADR-0002 A2 / ADR-0028 D9) — session, the viewer's own `profiles` row (`id, handle, avatar_path, role, is_banned` — data-model §4 "own row (full)"; never `public_profiles` for self, 02 §2.3), own held/hidden comments for the current target, own `comment_likes`; **plus, for moderators only, RPC `moderator_thread(target_type, target_id)`** (security definer, `is_moderator()`-gated; held/hidden/reported rows + `is_first_comment` + `report_count`) — the allowed exception to INV-09 / C-17 (ADR-0002 A2). `lib/supabase/client.ts` is imported by exactly three files under `components/**`: `components/accounts/ViewerProvider.tsx`, `components/comments/CommentThread.tsx`, `components/primitives/GoogleSignInButton.tsx` (01 INV-85 lint; `AdminGate` is `S` and renders `GoogleSignInButton`, it imports nothing itself). Mutations go through `lib/actions/*` (04) via `<form action>`, `useActionState`, or `startTransition`. |
| C-17a | **Session-aware UI on ISR pages = client seam (DECIDED, ADR-0002 C1; O-22).** The ISR shell never varies by user (01 INV-39). `ViewerProvider` (client, mounted once in `app/(public)/layout.tsx`) resolves the session after hydration and exposes `useViewer()` → `{ status: 'loading'\|'anon'\|'signed-in'; viewer: { id; handle; avatarUrl; role; isBanned } \| null }` (**binding shape — camelCase like 04's `CommentView`; `viewer` is the own `profiles` row `id, handle, avatar_path, role, is_banned` mapped to camelCase, `avatarUrl` resolved from `avatar_path`**); every session-aware leaf (`Nav`'s sign-in slot, `ProfileMenu`, `Composer` enablement, `LikeButton` liked state, mod toggles) takes viewer state from `useViewer()`, never from props on ISR pages. Public comments arrive **server-side** as props (`lib/data/comments.ts` over view `comments_public`, cache tag `project:<slug>`); `CommentThread` (client) merges in the viewer's own held/hidden rows and own likes read client-side under RLS (C-17 exception 5). While `status==='loading'` the leaves render the signed-out shape (no layout shift). **No PPR, no `experimental.*`, no `<Suspense>` server partials for session data.** `NavSession`, `Nav.Viewer`, `CommentThreadSection` do not exist. |
| C-18 | Heavy client dependencies are lazy: `skinview3d` (`next/dynamic`, `ssr:false`, in `SkinViewer3D` only), `Lightbox` (dynamic import on first open, 01 INV-10). `react-markdown`+`remark-gfm` are imported **only** in `lib/markdown.ts` (01 INV-65/INV-86); the `Markdown` Server Component wraps `renderMarkdown()` and imports nothing from those packages; they never enter a client bundle (there is no client markdown preview in v1 — O-23, closed: 01 v0.2 INV-10 already agrees). Any new client dep > 50 KB gz → stop and ask (web-quality; ADR-R5). |
| C-19 | Composition pattern: a server parent renders the shell and passes serialisable props (or server-rendered `children`) to a small client leaf (`Nav` → `NavLinks` + `NavMenuButton`; `VersionsTable` → `ChangelogExpander` (children = server-rendered `Markdown`); `AdminShell` → `AdminNav`; `ArtMasonry` → `ArtMasonryLightbox`). Prop values must be JSON-serialisable (no Dates, no functions except server actions). |

Not on the list, therefore Server Components (01 INV-08 "everything else"): `Nav` (shell), `Footer`, `Button`, `Select`, `Field`, `Table`, `Chip`, `Markdown`, `FlatBarChart` (O-23 closed), `ProjectCard`, `GetItPanel`, `VersionsTable`, `TipPanel`, `FeaturedHero`, `SkinCard`, `ArtMasonry`, `ArtCard`, `VideoCard`, `ReachLine`, `SeenOnRow`, `InTheWildStrip`, `Leaderboard`, `AdminShell` (shell), `AdminGate`, `ProjectCardSkeleton`, `ProjectDetailSkeleton`, all `emails/`. `Sh` components (`Button`, `Chip`, `PixelLabel`, `Avatar`, `Icon`, `SectionTitle`, `EmptyState`, `SignInPrompt`, `HeldNotice`, `Reply`, `Skeleton`, `CommentThreadSkeleton`, …) carry no directive and are never listed; they become client only when imported by a client parent (e.g. inside `CommentThread`).

### 1.5 Reuse — do not create a new component if…
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-20 | …a §2 row already covers it with a variant/state (a "gold button" is `Button data-variant="gold"`; a "selected chip" is `Chip selected` (`aria-checked`/`aria-current`); a "held row status" is `StatusPill status="held"`). Duplicates = ❌ from `spec-drift-reviewer` check 4. |
| C-21 | …it is a page-level arrangement of existing components (project detail header, "What it pays for" slab, the Find-me column). Those are composed inside `app/**` route files or `components/<area>/<Page>Section.tsx` **only if** used on ≥2 routes; otherwise inline in the route (framework-decision guardrail "no abstraction until needed twice"). |
| C-22 | …it is a Silkscreen micro-label (`PixelLabel`), a section header (`SectionTitle`), a status word (`StatusPill`), a square picture (`Avatar`), an empty state (`EmptyState`), a one-line inline confirm (`InlineConfirm`), a third-party logo (`PlatformMark`), a source colour (`SourceSwatch`), or a NOTE box (`NoteCallout`). Those primitives exist for exactly that reason (§2.2; all in `_registry.md`). |
| C-23 | A component that DESIGN.md does not describe cannot be added by a build PR alone: it needs (a) a DESIGN.md §-reference, or (b) a DESIGN.md edit + `keep-docs` + an ADR in `docs/build/06-decisions/`, and (c) a row added to this doc and to `_registry.md`. `design-fidelity` stops and asks otherwise. |

### 1.6 A11y and motion baseline (applies to every row)
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-24 | Minimum hit target 44×44 CSS px on every interactive element (DESIGN.md §5). Visual size may be smaller (chips, 28px trigger) only with padding/pseudo-element making the target 44. |
| C-25 | Focus: `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px }` defined once in `globals.css`; components never remove it and never set `outline: none` without replacing it with the same ring. |
| C-26 | Meaning never rides on colour alone: badges = glyph + word; statuses = worded pills; active nav = underline; selected chips = fill + `aria-checked`/`aria-current`; charts = swatch + word; toggles = ON/OFF word (DESIGN.md §1, §9, §11.1). |
| C-27 | Text minimums: body ≥16px (`--text-body` 17px desktop / 16 phone), UI/prose never <13px, Silkscreen ≥10px and ≥11px when informational (counts, `HELD FOR REVIEW`, `N TOTAL`, view counts). Bungee ≥16px for titles; 12–15px only for button/filter/support labels. |
| C-28 | Motion: transitions 120–180ms ease-out, moves ≤4px, one idle animation per page; under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` transforms are dropped and colour changes kept (globals.css sets `* { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, box-shadow }` under the media query). Skeleton pulse holds at opacity .8. |
| C-29 | Images: `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; every image has `alt` (empty `alt=""` only for the decorative hatch/avatars duplicating adjacent text); pixel art (`skins`, project icons, allay) uses `image-rendering: pixelated` at integer scales. |
| C-30 | Copy inside components follows DESIGN.md §7: no emoji (the `♥ ★ ✔ ✕ ⏳ ⠿ ▾ ↗` characters DESIGN.md prescribes are typographic glyphs and allowed exactly where prescribed), "Download" never "Get", handles only, plain-language errors inline beside the thing that failed, never a modal for errors. |

### 2.10 Admin (`components/admin/`)

Admin-only controls rule (02 §1.3 auth rule, ADR-0002 C7): on admin pages a moderator sees every admin-only mutation control (`SyncStatus` "Sync now", `Toggle` feature/hide switches, `ReorderableList` handles, `UploadWell`, curate/save `Button`s) **rendered disabled** — `disabled`/`aria-disabled="true"` + `title="Admin only"` — never hidden and never leading to a `forbidden` error; the page passes the viewer's role down as a boolean prop (e.g. `canTrigger`, `disabled`).

## 3. State vocabulary (canonical `data-state` values)

| Component | `data-state` values (mutually exclusive) | ARIA/flags used instead |
|---|---|---|
| `NavMenuButton` (panel) | `open` \| `closed` | `aria-expanded` on burger; `aria-current="page"` on links (`NavLinks`) |
| `FloatingSupportButton` | `visible` \| `hidden` | `data-compact` |
| `Toast` | `entering` \| `visible` \| `leaving` | `role=status` |
| `Button` | — | `disabled`, `aria-busy` (pending); `data-variant` incl. `gold-ink` |
| `Chip` | — | `aria-current` (links) / `aria-checked` (radio chips), `aria-disabled` (unavailable) |
| `Toggle` | — | `aria-checked`, `disabled` |
| `Field` / `Select` | — | `aria-invalid`, `disabled` |
| `HandleField` | `resting` \| `checking` \| `available` \| `invalid` | `aria-invalid` |
| `AvatarUpload` | `empty` \| `cropping` \| `uploading` \| `error` \| `done` | `role=progressbar` |
| `UploadWell` | `idle` \| `dragover` \| `uploading` \| `done` \| `error` | `role=progressbar`, `role=alert` |
| `VideoFacade` | `idle` \| `loading` \| `playing` | — |
| `Lightbox` | `open` \| `closing` | `<dialog open>`, `aria-modal` |
| `SkinViewer3D` | `loading` \| `ready` \| `unsupported` | `aria-pressed` on Spin/Walk |
| `CommentThread` | `normal` \| `empty` \| `closed` \| `banned` \| `signed-out` | `data-moderate="on\|off"` on the root; pending optimistic bubble = `aria-busy` |
| `Comment` | `published` \| `held` \| `hidden` \| `deleted` \| `editing` | `data-own`, `data-creator`, `data-mod`, `data-depth="0\|1"` |
| `Composer` | `idle` \| `submitting` \| `error` | `aria-invalid`, `aria-busy` |
| `LikeButton` | — | `aria-pressed` |
| `ReportPicker` | `picking` \| `sending` \| `done` \| `error` | `role=radiogroup` + `role=radio aria-checked` |
| `InlineConfirm` | `closed` \| `open` \| `pending` | — |
| `ProfileMenu` | `open` \| `closed` | `aria-expanded`, `role=menu`; anon/loading slot renders `GoogleSignInButton` (no state) |
| `OnboardingPanel` | `idle` \| `submitting` \| `error` | — |
| `ProfilePanel` | `idle` \| `submitting` \| `error` | `aria-busy` on the submit `Button` (`pending`); delete pending is `InlineConfirm`'s own `pending` (ADR-0014) |
| `BannedDelete` | `idle` \| `error` | delete pending is `InlineConfirm`'s own `pending`; error line `role="alert"` (ADR-0021) |
| `MentionCard` | `idle` \| `playing` | — |
| `MentionPreview` | `empty` \| `preview` \| `error` \| `manual` | `aria-live` |
| `AmountPicker` | — | `role=radiogroup` + `role=radio aria-checked` |
| `KofiPanelSlot` | `idle` \| `loaded` | — |
| `ProjectCard` / `SkinCard` | — | `data-exclusive`, `aria-current` (SkinCard selected) |
| `GetItPanel` | — | `data-sticky` |
| `LeaderboardRow` | — | `data-anonymous` |
| `ChangelogExpander` | — | `aria-expanded` on the summary button; expanded `<tr hidden>` toggled |
| `ReorderableList` (row) | `grabbed` \| (none) | `aria-live` announcements |
| `SyncStatus` (row) | — | `aria-busy` on the Sync now button |

Rule C-31: a component's `.module.css` may only select the values listed for it here (`[data-state="held"]`); a selector for an unlisted value = ❌.

## 4. Nav specification (S0, S1.1, S1.2, S2.2)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| N-01 | Sticky top bar: `position: sticky; top: 0`, height 68px desktop / 56px phone (`--nav-h`, `--nav-h-phone`), background `--slab`, `border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line)`, `z-index: var(--z-nav)`. Content max-width `--measure-page` (1280), gutters 24 phone / 40–56 desktop. |
| N-02 | Left: `Avatar size=40` (default 3px `--white` border — DESIGN.md §3) of the OddSense avatar (`public/brand/avatar-80.png`, `alt="OddSense"`) + wordmark `ODSENS` (Bungee 20px, `--white`), together one `<a href="/">` with `aria-label="odsens home"`. **There is no Home item.** |
| N-03 | Desktop link order (≥900px), exactly: **Projects** (`/projects`) · **Videos** (`/videos`) · **Skins** (`/skins`) · **Art** (`/art`) · **Seen on** (`/seen-on`) · **Commissions** (`/commissions`, rendered only when `FLAGS.commissions` from `lib/flags.ts` is true — false until S2.2; 01 INV-74). Space Grotesk 15px 500 `--mute`, padding 10×14 (O-11, ADR-0002 #52; DESIGN.md §12.7). Hover: `--chalk`. Active: `aria-current="page"`, `--white` 700, `box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold)`. **Active item = pathname `===` href or `startsWith(href + '/')`** (02 RP-12; `/projects/[slug]` highlights Projects). Support is **never** in this row. Rendered by `NavLinks` (client leaf, `usePathname`). |
| N-04 | Right side, in order: `SearchBox placement="nav"` (renders itself only on `/projects` — RP-12) · viewer slot = `ProfileMenu` (client, `useViewer()` — ADR-0002 C1): anon/loading → `GoogleSignInButton label="Sign in" from="nav"` styled as the outlined block (14px 700, 2px `--line-strong`) / signed-in → the menu trigger · gold Support `Button variant="gold" size="sm" href="/support"` label `♥ SUPPORT` (Bungee 12px, `3px 3px 0 --gold-deep`; the floating one is 13px/4px — O-11, ADR-0002 #52) — a **plain link, no `TrackedLink`, no `tip_click` event** (ADR-0002 A16). |
| N-05 | Under 900px: links + Sign in/ProfileMenu collapse behind a 44px square `<button aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded aria-controls="nav-menu">` (`Icon menu` / `close`) = `NavMenuButton`. Its panel opens as a full-width `--slab` panel under the bar with the same order, **Support last** (as a full-width gold `Button`). Wordmark and (on ≥600px) the gold Support button stay visible in the bar; on phone (≤599px) the Support button lives only in the menu (O-10, ADR-0002 #51). Esc closes; focus returns to the burger; body scroll locked while open. |
| N-06 | Admin link: role ≥ moderator sees "Admin" inside `ProfileMenu`, not in the row (admin login page not linked publicly — security-check; O-6). Nav links to `/projects` · `/videos` · `/skins` · `/art` · `/seen-on` · `/support` resolve from S0: placeholder pages (title + "Not yet. Soon.") until each slice replaces them (ADR-0002 C20). |
| N-07 | `SkipLink` is rendered before `Nav`; `<main id="main">` follows. |
| N-08 | Nav has no idle animation; menu open/close is 150ms opacity/translate ≤4px; reduced-motion = opacity only. |
| N-09 | `Nav` (server shell in `app/(public)/layout.tsx` — ADR-0002 C5; the root `app/layout.tsx` carries html/body/fonts/tokens only) takes no props: link list is a constant in `Nav.tsx`, `FLAGS.commissions` is read directly (`grep -n "FLAGS.commissions" components/layout/Nav.tsx` must hit — 01 INV-74 check), the viewer slot is `ProfileMenu` reading `useViewer()` from the `ViewerProvider` mounted in the same layout (C-17a, ADR-0002 C1). |

## 5. Global states — skeletons, 404, error, toast, empty (S0, per DESIGN.md §11)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| G-01 | Every route segment that fetches data has `loading.tsx` rendering the matching skeleton: **`app/(public)/loading.tsx` = hero-slab `Skeleton kind=media` + 4 `ProjectCardSkeleton` inside the page shell (02 RP-09/§6; nav/footer render from the layout)**; `/projects` → `ProjectCardSkeleton count=6` in the real grid; `/projects/[slug]` → `ProjectDetailSkeleton` (incl. the thread block as `CommentThreadSkeleton`); other data pages → `Skeleton` blocks in the page shell (02 §6 table). Never more than one screenful; nav/footer render immediately (they are outside the suspense boundary). |
| G-02 | `app/not-found.tsx` = 80px Bungee `404` in `--indigo` (on `--ink`; the numeral is decorative-large, contrast rule exempt because "THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST" carries the meaning), then Bungee "THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST" (`--chalk`), "Probably never did." (`--mute`), `Button primary` GO HOME + `Button ghost` "See the projects". `h1` = THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST. Route-level `notFound()` from `/projects/[slug]`, `/admin/*` (signed-in non-moderator — ADR-0002 C4; moderator on `/admin/settings`), `/dev/components` on Vercel (ADR-0002 #44) etc. renders the same. |
| G-03 | `app/error.tsx` and `app/global-error.tsx` (client boundaries, Next requirement — **the two allowed `'use client'` route files outside §2, both on the C-16a list**) = 64px `--alert` square with `!` (Bungee, `--white`) and `5px 5px 0 var(--alert-deep)`, "SOMETHING BROKE", "Not your fault. Reload and it's usually fine. If it isn't, it's on the list.", `Button primary` RELOAD (`reset()`) + `Button ghost` "Go home". **No error codes or stack text**; the digest is logged, not shown. `app/global-error.tsx` mirrors it with inline minimal styles (no CSS Modules guaranteed there). |
| G-04 | Toasts: only success confirmations of ≤3 words ("Comment posted." · "Saved." · "Copied." · "Approved." · "Hidden." · "Banned." · "Sync started." · "Published."). Errors are never toasts (C-30). Bottom-left so it never overlaps `FloatingSupportButton` (bottom-right). |
| G-05 | Empty states use `EmptyState` with the DESIGN.md §11.7/§12.4/§11.2 strings verbatim: Videos "NO VIDEOS YET / They'll show up here when they exist." → channel link · Skins "NO SKINS YET / Working on it. Check the projects meanwhile." · Art "NO ART HERE YET / Nothing in this filter. Try \"all\"." · Projects "NOTHING MATCHES / Try fewer filters." → Clear filters · Comments "NO COMMENTS YET / Say something." → primary button · Leaderboard "NOBODY YET / Be first." · Admin orders (S2.2) "No orders yet / Quiet week. The form still works." · **Seen on surfaces with zero mentions render nothing** (§12.1); `/seen-on` filter-with-no-results → `EmptyState` "NOTHING HERE / Try another filter." (O-25, ADR-0002 #62). **Placeholder pages** (S0, ADR-0002 C20): `/projects`, `/videos`, `/skins`, `/art`, `/seen-on`, `/support` render their title + one voice line "Not yet. Soon." (DESIGN.md §12.7) until their slice ships — plain page copy, not `EmptyState`. Admin tables with no rows: `Table empty=` one `--mute` line in voice per 02 §1.3 ("Nothing held. Nice." · "No projects yet. Run a sync." · "Nothing pasted yet." · "Nothing here yet." · "No videos yet.") — O-12, ADR-0002 #40; `write-copy` voice pass before S1.10. `/admin/stats` before any snapshot: tiles `0` + "No data yet." (ADR-0002 #29). |
| G-06 | Skeleton colours: `--skeleton-media` (= `#1E2938`, alias of `--slab-raised`) and `--skeleton-text` (`#1A2432`); pulse `--dur-skeleton` 1.6s opacity 1→.55; `prefers-reduced-motion` → static opacity .8. |

## 6. Email components (`emails/`) — email-safe subset (DESIGN.md §12.1, `docs/notifications.md`)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| E-01 | Files: `emails/components/{EmailLayout,EmailButton,EmailBadge}.tsx`, `emails/templates/{CommentNew,CommentHeld,CommentReported,SyncFailed,Digest}.tsx` (`Digest` = the 04 N2 digest body — ADR-0030 D7; P2: `OrderNew`, `WorkroomUpdate`), `emails/components/shared.tsx` (the hex-mirror module + the template-internal `Lead`/`Meta`/`Excerpt`/`Actions` helpers); `emails/preview/*.tsx` default-export (react-email's preview requirement — a C-03 exception recorded by ADR-0030 D15), `emails/preview/*` for `pnpm email dev`. Rendered only in `lib/notify/deliver/email.ts` via `@react-email/render` → `{ html, text }`. Never imported by `app/**` or `components/**`. |
| E-02 | Styles are inline (React Email `style={{}}` — the one place inline styles are mandatory) using the DESIGN.md hex values listed in §2.11; a unit test asserts every hex used in `emails/**` exists in `styles/tokens.css` (parity check, since `var()` does not work in mail). |
| E-03 | Allowed subset: `background-color`, `color`, `border: 2px solid`, `padding`, `font-family` fallbacks (Impact, "Arial Black", Arial, sans-serif for display; Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif for body), `font-size ≥ 13px` (body 16), `text-transform`, `letter-spacing`, `width` on tables/images. **Forbidden**: `outline`, `box-shadow`, gradients/hatch, web fonts, animation, `border-radius` other than 0, JavaScript, remote CSS. Exception: `EmailBadge` is Arial 11px bold uppercase per §2.11 (the ≥ 13px floor is for body/footer text — ADR-0030 D15). React Email's `Img` reset `outline:none` on the wordmark `<img>` is accepted — the ban is on `outline` used as a border; T-UNIT-3 greps for radius/shadow/animation/script, not `outline`. |
| E-04 | Layout is table-based, max 600px, explicit dark backgrounds on `body`, wrapper and card (Gmail dark-mode inversion guard); `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">` + `supported-color-schemes`. |
| E-05 | Exactly one `EmailButton` per template; `tone="gold"` only in `CommentHeld` (APPROVE). Every template has: preview text, `EmailBadge` for the event kind, the allay lead line from DESIGN.md §12.1 verbatim, one excerpt (≤ 280 chars, HTML-escaped, links stripped — as built: URLs matching the 04 §1.2 B3 pattern are removed from every excerpt before it is quoted, at the source in `lib/notify/deliver/content.ts` `stripLinks` and again in `emails/components/shared.tsx` `stripLinks` as the template's own defence; leftover spaces collapse; a link-only excerpt renders as an empty pair of quotes in a single mail and drops the quote line in the digest; the Discord description follows the same rule — 04 N6), the button, footer with "The allay emails you because <switch> is on." + "Manage in Settings" (absolute URL to `/admin/settings`) + one dry sign-off. |
| E-06 | Plain-text version is generated for every send (`render(..., { plainText: true })`) and passed to Resend `text`. Subject lines are ≤ 60 chars, no emoji — as built: `subjectFor` clips the title half so the whole subject is ≤ 60 code points including the ellipsis (`SUBJECT_MAX`, T-UNIT-26). |
| E-07 | Wordmark ships as PNG (`public/brand/email/wordmark.png` 84×20 + `wordmark@2x.png` 168×40, both rendered from `public/fonts/bungee-400.woff2` by the human-run `scripts/render-wordmark.mjs`; templates reference the 2× file at 84×20 `width`/`height` attributes for retina — ADR-0030 D15; `alt="odsens"`); the allay 28px header image is added when the asset lands (Q44) — templates must not break without it. Images are absolute `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` URLs. |
| E-08 | No PII in template props (types accept `handle`, never email/name); admin recipient addresses are applied by the deliverer, not the template. Discord embeds are not React components — `lib/notify/deliver/discord.ts` builds the JSON (title "Event — Project", excerpt, "View" link, colour bar indigo `#4B45D6` default / gold `#FFC61F` held+reported / alert `#CC3A2A` failures; username `allay`, avatar = allay render URL when it exists). |
| E-09 | `design-fidelity` covers `emails/` (notifications.md): the reviewer opens `pnpm email dev` renders or the exported HTML and checks E-02–E-07. |

## 7. Preview / story approach

**DECIDED (ADR-0002 #44; O-1)** — a dev-only route `app/dev/components/page.tsx` (`/dev/components`) that returns `notFound()` when `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'` **and** on any Vercel deployment (`process.env.VERCEL_ENV` set) — it exists only for `pnpm dev`/local Playwright. It renders every §2 component in every §3 state from `tests/fixtures/ui/*.ts` fixture data (no DB), grouped by area, each block labelled with `PixelLabel` "<Name> · <state>" and wrapped in `<section data-preview="<Name>">`. Purposes: `design-fidelity` screenshots (1280 + 390) diffed against the **pass-2 and pass-3 prototypes per component** (`design/claude-design-export/pass-2/*.dc.html` for the base set the gate agent names, `pass-3/*.dc.html` for the §12 additions), axe on the whole set (05 T-E2E-48, S0), contrast script. No Storybook (extra toolchain for Oliver; a route is one file). Emails preview via `pnpm email dev` (already decided). The route is in `_registry.md` (Non-production); an ADR with slug `component-preview` (`Kind: addition`, number per 06 README) is filed at S0. Filed as ADR-0004 (2026-08-17).

**Live-state exception (ADR-0014; the `Toast` precedent):** `InlineConfirm`, the `checking` / `available` states of `HandleField` and the `cropping` state of `AvatarUpload` render on `/dev/components` as static descriptions (a labelled block stating the state) because those states need a live action or a real file.
